label: PF Backlog 626
title: Dynamic/runtime agents are not auto-registered; runtime contract resolution silently skips them (no fail-closed)
body: Dynamic/runtime agents are not covered by the agent registry and runtime contract resolution silently skips them. Evidence: core/review_ledger.py::create_agent (BI-0117) + core/agent_spec.py::save_spec write agents/<id>.agent.json but do NOT register the agent in config/agent-registry/index.json. At runtime, core.contracts.resolve(agent=<new>) finds no spec -> falls back to agents.json by_agent -> empty -> no contracts -> artifact validation is a silent no-op. The coverage gate catches a missing registry entry only at the NEXT CI/precheck run (not at runtime). No fail-closed for an unknown agent.
